ammonia.reason: Minimal NH3 from amino acid deamination; young low proteolysis and acidic pH retains NH4+.

animal_barnyard.reason: Trace p-cresol/indole from tyrosine/tryptophan catabolism; pasteurized milk limits farm notes.

bitter.reason: Low hydrophobic bitter peptides from alpha-s1 casein; short age limits accumulation.

blue_moldy.reason: No Penicillium roqueforti; 2-heptanone low and 2-nonanone absent, no blue ketone pathway.

browning.reason: Maillard limited by low residual lactose/galactose and high 42% moisture on heating.

buttery.reason: Modest diacetyl/acetoin from Lactococcus lactis biovar diacetylactis citrate metabolism.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Low butanoic/hexanoic acids from limited starter esterase lipolysis in young curd.

creaminess.reason: 33% fat lubricates but acidic demineralized matrix fractures rather than creams.

crumbliness.reason: Low pH 4.73 calcium solubilization plus milled-salted curd gives short friable fracture.

firmness.reason: Pressed 42% moisture demineralized casein network gives firm but not hard body.

floral_honey.reason: Trace phenylacetaldehyde/2-phenylethanol from phenylalanine catabolism, masked by acidity.

fruity.reason: Trace ethyl butyrate from starter esterase esterification; ethyl hexanoate essentially absent.

goaty.reason: No caprine branched C8-C10 acids; cow milk only so 4-methyloctanoic absent.

malty_nutty.reason: Low Strecker 3-methylbutanal/2-methylbutanal from leucine/isoleucine due to short ripening.

melt.reason: Rennet gel but pH 4.73 calcium-depleted para-casein flows poorly to grainy softening.

mushroom_earthy.reason: Trace 1-octen-3-ol from linoleic acid oxidation; no surface mold to amplify.

oil_off.reason: Moderate free oil on heating; young intact protein network entraps most fat.

smoky.reason: Unsmoked make, no guaiacol/syringol from wood smoke.

sour_vinegar.reason: High L-lactic plus acetic acid from mesophilic starter post-acidification to pH 4.73.

stretch.reason: No pasta-filata stretching; acidic non-aligned casein cannot form fibers.

sulfur_cooked.reason: Minimal H2S/methanethiol from methionine catabolism; curd not high-cooked.

sweet.reason: Lactose fermented to lactate; little residual sugar sweetness remains.

umami.reason: Low free glutamate from limited chymosin and starter peptidase proteolysis at 2-3 mo.
